Oliver,

we used before but does not exist in annotate/data any more. I will let the 
maintainer of the package know about the change and have the bug fixed. Thanks.

Jianhua

messages.subject: [BioC] help with  library(NBIR)
messages.body_plain:
hi -- my experience with NBIR under R 1.5 is that
it fails because SNetscape and the methods library
are incompatible.  NBIR has not been touched for
some time owing to that.

If you have evidence to the contrary let me know
and I will try to rebuild and correct the
current bugs.

Let me know what version of R you are running and
on what platform please.

---
Vince Carey, PhD
